title: Module 01: Sequence Basics & Bio.Seq
description: Biological string representations, nucleotide alphabets, standard IUPAC definitions, and Seq object transformations.

title: Module 02: Transcription & Translation
description: Coding vs. template strand mechanics, codon mapping, stop-codon terminations, and open reading frame (ORF) extraction.

title: Module 05: FASTA & GenBank I/O (Bio.SeqIO)
description: High-throughput stream parsing of massive FASTA and multi-record GenBank flatfiles using Bio.SeqIO.parse iterator paradigms.

title: Module 10: NCBI Entrez API Programmatic Querying
description: Connecting to NCBI E-utilities via Bio.Entrez (ESearch, EFetch, ESummary) for PubMed, GenBank, and Nucleotide lookups.

title: Module 15: Multiple Sequence Alignment (Bio.AlignIO)
description: ClustalW, MUSCLE, and PHYLIP format parsing, consensus sequence generation, and evolutionary substitution profiling.

title: Module 20: BLAST Automation & XML Parsing
description: qblast remote submission, local BLAST+ executable wrapping, and HSP (High Scoring Pair) parameter extraction.

title: Module 25: Macromolecular Structural Biology (Bio.PDB)
description: SMCRA (Structure, Model, Chain, Residue, Atom) hierarchy, vector math, torsion angles (phi/psi), and SASA calculations.

title: Module 30: End-to-End Metagenomics & Capstone Pipeline
description: Automated pipeline uniting QC, assembly, taxonomic classification, and phylogenetic tree rendering.

title: Cambridge ML: Bias-Variance Tradeoff & CV
description: Decomposition of mean squared error into intrinsic noise, squared bias, and variance across $k$-fold cross-validation.

title: Cambridge ML: Decision Trees & Cost-Complexity Pruning
description: Top-down recursive partitioning, greedy binary splitting, and weak-link cost-complexity regularized tree pruning.

title: Cambridge ML: Random Forests & Out-Of-Bag Error
description: De-correlating tree ensembles via random feature subspacing and obtaining unbiased out-of-bag validation bounds.

title: Cambridge ML: Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces (RKHS)
description: Infinite-dimensional function spaces, the Riesz Representation Theorem, and the Kimeldorf-Wahba Representer Theorem.

title: Cambridge ML: L1 vs L2 Regularization in High Dimensions
description: Sparsity induction via $L_1$ norm (Lasso) vs $L_2$ shrinkage (Ridge) in genomic $p \gg n$ expression regimes.

title: Cambridge ML: AdaBoost & Gradient Boosting Theory
description: Exponential loss minimization, weak learner reweighting dynamics, and functional gradient descent in hypothesis spaces.

title: Cambridge ML: Forward Stagewise Boosting & Lasso Equivalence
description: Mathematical proof that infinitesimal Forward Stagewise linear boosting traces the exact continuous Lasso path.

title: Agent-Based Modeling & Wa-Tor Marine Lattice
description: Simulating non-linear predator-prey limit cycles and spatial wave-fronts on discrete toroidal cellular automata grids.

title: Boids Collective Swarming & Evasive Kinematics
description: Craig Reynolds steering forces (separation, alignment, cohesion) and predator avoidance kinetics in collective biology.

title: Differential Expression (DESeq2) Architecture
description: Negative binomial dispersion shrinkage, size-factor geometric mean normalization, and Wald statistical hypothesis testing.

title: AlphaFold DB Programmatic API & Coordinates
description: Automated retrieval of predicted 3D coordinates (mmCIF/PDB), per-residue pLDDT confidence scoring, and PAE matrices.

title: Miyazawa-Jernigan Statistical Contact Potentials
description: Quasi-chemical energy potentials based on observed pairwise non-bonded amino acid contacts within protein crystal structures.

title: ChIP-Seq Peak Calling & TF Binding Loci
description: Cross-correlation analysis, fragment length estimation, and Poisson / dynamic lambda background modeling using MACS2.

title: Academic Scientific Communication & Cambridge MPhil Roadmap
description: Statistical reporting precision, research dissemination conventions, and master's application strategy for Cambridge University.
